propositions: DC backend lacks value-level characterization tests; existing test_backend_characterization.py pins Cloud only (hardbound to JiraBackend at lines 24-25) while test_backend_contract.py asserts shape not values for both vendors

create-path mapper _map_local_to_dc_fields emits six fields (summary, description, issuetype, priority, status, assignee) with separate DC implementations distinct from Cloud's, requiring per-vendor value pinning of every key and fallback branch

shared OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote body is exercised only through AdfCodec, not WikiTextCodec, leaving DC composition (truncation, type guards, status/priority branches) without regression detection
DC sanitizer truncation boundaries and suffix markers for summary, description, and comment must be pinned at-limit and one-over

DC probe classification must pin all four branches (PRESENT_RESOLVED, PRESENT_FILTERED, ARCHIVED_OR_MOVED, UNREACHABLE) through real classifier not FakeTransport stub, and prove DC binds its own resolved_statuses config against a non-default set to avoid vacuous parity assertions
DC identity label format and all mapped type/priority/status constants must be pinned by exact value with mutation verification recorded in test module and ticket
